project.name: BookBox
project.vision: Let readers of a five-store independent book chain find a title, see which store has it, and buy it for delivery or pickup, while staff and managers stop tracking orders on Messenger and paper.
goals: Reach 30% of revenue online within 6 months
Keep order handling time per order under 3 minutes
Keep stock mismatch complaints under 1% of orders

in: Catalogue search by title, author and ISBN with stock visibility per store
Shopping cart and checkout with an optional discount voucher
Payment by card or e-wallet through a payment gateway, or cash on delivery; wallet top-up with the same online payment
Home delivery or in-store pickup, order tracking, and cancelling an order before it is packed
Loyalty points earned per order and redeemable at checkout when the member has enough points
Product reviews by members who bought the book
Manager stock and price editing and voucher creation; owner sales report across stores

actors.name: Payment Gateway
actors.description: Card and e-wallet provider that charges online orders and wallet top-ups and reports the result through an asynchronous callback.

actors.name: Shipping Partner
actors.description: Delivery company API that creates delivery orders and pushes delivery status updates.

actors.name: Email Service
actors.description: Transactional email provider that sends order confirmations and password reset mail.

business_rules.statement: An order can be cancelled by the member only before it is packed.
Card data is never stored; the payment gateway tokenises it.

addendum.content: Guests browse the catalogue; registered members buy, review and collect loyalty points; store staff pack orders and hand over pickups; each store manager manages stock, prices and promotions for their store; the head-office owner sees sales across all five stores.
addendum.content_en: Guests browse the catalogue; registered members buy, review and collect loyalty points; store staff pack orders and hand over pickups; each store manager manages stock, prices and promotions for their store; the head-office owner sees sales across all five stores.

addendum.content: Customers call stores to ask whether a title is in stock, staff take orders over Messenger and lose track of them, managers cannot see stock across stores, and loyalty points live on paper cards.
addendum.content_en: Customers call stores to ask whether a title is in stock, staff take orders over Messenger and lose track of them, managers cannot see stock across stores, and loyalty points live on paper cards.

addendum.content: A payment gateway for card and e-wallet with an asynchronous payment-result callback; a shipping partner API that creates delivery orders and pushes delivery status updates; a transactional email service for order confirmations and password reset.
addendum.content_en: A payment gateway for card and e-wallet with an asynchronous payment-result callback; a shipping partner API that creates delivery orders and pushes delivery status updates; a transactional email service for order confirmations and password reset.

addendum.content: A job cancels orders left unpaid for 15 minutes and releases their reserved stock; a nightly job expires loyalty points older than 12 months.
